purpose: B2 standard-model pipeline/coexistence baseline; no autonomous tuning
depth: uniform synthetic aligned 1.5m only for fixed replay; live uses D435i SDK depth

audio_input.kind: B0 synthesized fixture, no physical microphone

vision_prompt: 请简短描述当前画面，最多两句话，不要调用工具。
background_policy: Single backlogged caller, no queued requests. Audio and image chat use production TurnController/VAD/ASR/LLM/TTS/actions with isolated stores; session cleared between requests, native prompt cache preserved. LLM-only pressure reuses the B0 BackgroundLLM workload. End-window in-flight request is cancelled and reported as censored.
llm_only_prompt: 用中文分点介绍如何分析程序的性能，先测量再定位瓶颈，回答尽量具体。
backend_lifecycle: Fresh backend processes for each resident condition; stable PID/create-time checked before and after. Same clients/VAD/actions/control loaded in all resident conditions.
gesture_policy: Execute unchanged gesture rules but log events without dispatching to load requests. Gesture interaction acceptance is separate.
scope: Production Camera source publication, JPEG, bounded ring, B1Perception and tracking. Websocket/browser excluded. App control included as resident/pressure owner. Sources are not ground-truth pose/distance labels.
statistics: nearest-rank; report raw counts and missing results; unavailable samples rank after finite frame ages; pipeline compute, receive-to-start, post-JPEG wait, receive-to-complete and periodic latest-result age reported separately
isolation: No other tests/builds/downloads during timed windows. Preserve platform power/DVFS; record nvpmodel/tegrastats/source hashes. Restore prior services/profile in finally.
revision_note: Exactly three visual model replacements; B1 R2 input pixels, workload and seven unchanged models retained. Cross-model differences are not optimization gains.
